patch_list: Blocks ads, disables Blytics, Singular, Firebase Analytics and AppMetrica activation, and prevents Advertising ID lookups.
Adds Brazilian Portuguese translations for Notisave when the device language is Portuguese (Brazil).
Grants the local premium state the app reads for its paywall, VIP support, settings locks and ad-free UI.
